vLLM local provider routes requests via vllm/ model prefix with no auth

```elixir title="Elixir"
api_key = System.fetch_env!("API_KEY")
{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_chat_async(client, "{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"vllm/meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B\"}")
IO.inspect(result.choices)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.choices, 0).message.content)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.choices, 0).finish_reason)
IO.inspect(result.model)
```
